s: Din kelim hannittanim tachat hanner ubo t' seipim: asur litten keli menuqqab male shemen al pi hanner kede sheyyehe hashshemen metaptep kol shaa letok hanner, gezera shemma yistappeq mehashshemen shebbakkeli kevan sheeno mechubbar lanner, veyesh bazeh issur mishshum mekabbeh, sheal yede ken yikbeh hanner bizman qarob yoter meim lo haya mistappeq mimmennu kelum vehaya notep kullo letok hanner. Veap lehaomerim demuttar lachtok ner shel shaava haddoleq beyom tob veen bazeh mishshum mekabbeh, hoil ubeshaa shechotek mimmennu eno (mekabbeh) [makkeheh] oro kelal, veap al pi sheggorem lo likbot bimhera — en bekak kelum, kemo sheyyitbaer besimman tqy"d, ulepi dibrehem ap kan en bo mishshum mekabbeh keshennotel mehashshemen shebbakkeli, kevan sheeno makheh kelal et or hanner bishat netilato, shehare nishar adayin shemen bakkeli sheyyetaptep lanner, mikkol maqom chosheshin shemma yimmalek veyittol mehanner kol hashshemen im hakkeli o belo hakkeli, venimtza makheh or hanner bishat netilato, veyesh bazeh mishshum mekabbeh ledibre hakkol. Veim chibber hakkeli lanner chibbur yapeh besid o becharsit — hare zeh muttar, dekevan shechibbero lo naaseh keli echad, ubadul hu mimmennu mishshum issur shabbat kemo mehanner atzmo, velo yabo lehistappeq mimmennu:

Veken lo yemalle adam qeara shemen veyittenenna betzad hanner veyitten rosh happetila betokah bishbil shettehe shoebet mehashshemen shebbetokah, gezera shemma yistappeq mimmenna, kevan sheenah mechubberet lanner:

Asur litten keli beshabbat tachat ner haddoleq leqabbel bo shemen hannotep mehanner, mippene shehu mebattel keli mehekano, shehaya mukan mittechilla letaltelo veakshav osero betiltul mechamat hashshemen shebbetoko shehu muqtzeh mechamat issur, kemo sheyyitbaer besimman ra"t, vachakamim aseru lebattel keli mehekano, mippene sheddomeh keillu soter hakkeli. Abal muttar litteno sham mibbeod yom, veim lo natap letoko shemen beshabbat — muttar letaltelo, shello neesar bemachashaba bilbaddah. Veim yesh bikli dabar hammuttar — muttar lehannicho tachat hanner leqabbel bo shemen, shehare yukal letaltel hakkeli bishbil hahetter shebbetoko im hu beinyan shemmuttar letaltel bishbilo, veal derek sheyyitbaer besimman sh"t vesh"y:

Muttar litten keli mibbeod yom tachat hashshulchan shealayv doleq ner ubeshabbat achar haakila yasir et hashshulchan vehakkeli omed meatzmo tachat hanner, veen bazeh mah sheggorem beshabbat lebattel keli mehekano al yede hasarat hashshulchan, kevan sheeno mebattelo beyadayim beshabbat, veod shehare en nizharim millehasim keli al hashshulchan tachat hanner ap al pi shennapal bo shemen ki en mitkavven lekak, vekan gam ken eno mitkavven bahasarat hashshulchan beshabbat ella lehatztzalat hashshulchan, unetinat hakkeli tachtayv hayeta behetter mibbeod yom:

Muttar litten keli beshabbat tachat ner shel shaava o shel cheleb haddoleq leqabbel bo et hanner im yippol, sheen kan bittul keli mehekano, kevan sheepshar lenaer hanner mehakkeli miyyad sheyyippol shamma uletaltel hakkeli achar kak kemo sheyyirtzeh, sheen issur lenaer hanner mishshum issur kibbuy o habara, kemo sheyyitbaer besimman ra"z, vegam en issur mishshum tiltul muqtzeh, kevan sheeno metaltel hanner hammuqtzeh beyadayim ella menaer hakkeli vehu nopel meelayv, veen hakkeli naaseh basis ledabar haasur, kevan shello haya haissur betoko beben hashshemashot, vegam haya dato lenaaro (ayyen simman sh"t). Veeno domeh lintinat keli tachat hanner shel shemen leqabbel shemen hannotep, sheap sheepshar lenaer hashshemen mehakkeli, mikkol maqom hu eno chapetz bekak, shello lehapsid hashshemen, ubishbil kak hu noteno sham umebattelo mehekano:

Asur ligga bener doleq keshehu taluy, ap al pi sheeno metaltelo, veen issur bemuqtzeh bingia bealma, mikkol maqom asur, pen yitnadned qetzat minnegiato. Umikkol maqom, im haya debar hetter munnach alayv — muttar littelo mealayv (ubilbad shello yigga bo beyadayv). Veen lachush bemah shemmitnadned hanner al yede netilat oto dabar mealayv, lepi shehu tiltul min hatztzad veeno tiltul, kemo sheyyitbaer besimman shy"a. Bammeh debarim amurim? Bener shel shaava vekayyotze bo, abal im haya ner shel shemen taluy — asur littol dabar hammuttar mealayv, pen yitnadned hanner qetzat veyitqareb hashshemen el happetila veyitchayyeb mishshum mabir, o yitracheq qetzat mimmenna veyesh bo mishshum mekabbeh, kemo sheyyitbaer besimman ra"z:

Muttar litten keli beshabbat tachat ner leqabbel bo nitzotzot, sheen kan bittul keli mehekano, mippene shehannitzotzot en bahem mammash kelal, ulekak muttar littol hakkeli ap achar shennapelu hannitzotzot letoko. Abal asur litteno beshabbat leqabbel bo happechamin hannopelim mehappetila, lepi sheyyesh bahem mammash — neesar hakkeli betiltul achar shennapelu letoko. Veap al pi sheepshar lenaaram mimmennu uletaltelo achar kak kemo sheyyirtzeh, mikkol maqom kevan shei epshar lenaaram miyyad shennapelu letoko ad leachar sheyikbu, shello yitchayyeb mishshum mekabbeh umabir kedin hachoteh baggechalim, im ken hare hu mebattelo mehekano lepi shaa ad sheyyikbu happechamim, veasur lebattel keli mehekano apillu lepi shaa shello bimqom hepsed merubbeh, kemo shennitbaer besimman rs"v:

Keshennoten hakkeli tachat hanner leqabbel bo nitzotzot — lo yihyeh bikli mayim o shear mashqim, mippene shemmeqareb zeman kibbuy hannitzotzot sheyyikbu miyyad sheyyippelu shamma. Velo hittiru apillu bidleqa ligrom kibbuy ella beechad mishshene debarim, o sheyyihyu hammayim betok keli, kegon kele cheres chadashim meleim mayim shehem enam yekolim leqabbel haur ukeshemmaggia haur lahem hem mitbaqqeim umekabbim, shennimtza haur hu shemmekabbehu, vehaadam eno ella gorem bealma, shehare keshennatan hammayim bekelim ellu haya hepseq mechitztza ben hammayim lehaur, dehaynu dopne hakkeli. O apillu en hammayim betok keli, ella shehu beinyan sheen hammayim mekabbim mah shehudlaq kebar, ella shehem moneim haur millisrop yoter, kegon tallit sheachaza bah haur — muttar litten mashqeh al hattallit rachoq qetzat min haur, shekkesheyyaggia sham haur lo yukal lisrop yoter umeelayv yikbeh. Abal kan sheen dopne keli mapsiqim ben ner lemayim shebbakkeli shettachtayv, vehammayim mekabbim mammash et hannitzotzot — en zeh niqra geram kibbuy. Vaapillu mibbeod yom asur litten mayim likli zeh, gezera shemma yitten mishshechasheka. Veap al pi shekkol melaka hannaaset beshabbat meeleha en bah issur kelal ap im mittechilla naasa beyadayim samuk lachasheka, veen chosheshim shemma yabo laasot ken mishshettechshak, lepi shehakkol yodeim issur asiyyat melaka beshabbat velo yitu bazeh, abal kan yedammeh bedato sheen bazeh shum issur kelal ap mishshettechshak, kevan shennoten hammayim qodem nepilat hannitzotzot:

Umikkol maqom, muttar litten mayim baashashit shemmadliqim bah beereb shabbat kede lehagbiah hashshemen, dekevan sheeno mitkavven lekibbuy kelal — en lachush shemma yaaseh ken beshabbat. Venohagin lehattir ap im mitkavven lekibbuy, kede shello titqalqel haashashit keshettadliq happetila al shuleha, lepi shebbeemet en kan kibbuy kelal, sheap im lo yitten letoko mayim, kesheyyikleh hashshemen tikbeh happetila, veen hammayim memaharim hakkibbuy kelal, ella shemmagbihim hashshemen kede shello titqalqel haashashit keshettadliq happetila al shuleha im shemen meat mizzeer. Ulepi taam zeh, yesh mi sheomer sheap beshabbat muttar litten mayim laashashit im madliqah nokri letzorek choleh. Abal asur litten mayim letok shepoperet shettocheb bah ner shel shaava o shel cheleb apillu mibbeod yom, shehare keshemmaggia haur lesham — hammayim hem mekabbim mammash. (Abal muttar litchob hanner letok hachol vekayyotze bo beinyan shekkesheyyaggia haur lesham yimnaehu millisrop yoter veyikbeh meelayv, sheggeram kibbuy hu, kemo shennitbaer lemala, vaapillu mishshechasheka muttar laasot ken, kegon beyom tob, kemo sheyyitbaer besimman tqy"d):
